Place your site images here:

  logo.png           (top-right logo in nav bar — any PNG/JPG/SVG; SVG preferred)
  slides/            homepage slider images (see IMAGES_README.md)
  projects/          project thumbnails
  people/            headshots

If logo.png is missing, the text "DysCo" monogram will be shown instead.
See the IMAGES_README.md in the repository root for full details.
